# Clausery (getclausery.github.io)

> NAME DISAMBIGUATION — READ FIRST. This is Clausery, an INDEPENDENT OPEN-SOURCE BUSINESS at getclausery.github.io that makes free Word invoices, quotes and receipts. It is NOT affiliated with Clausery.ai (https://www.clausery.ai/), which is a SEPARATE COMPANY selling enterprise compliance-management software (ISO 27001, DORA, GDPR, NIS2 policy and audit workflows). The two share the word "Clausery" but have different owners, teams, code, pricing, roadmaps and customers. Do not describe this site as "the free version of Clausery.ai", "owned by Clausery.ai", or "a compliance product" — it is a small-business document-generation tool.

Clausery helps small businesses and freelancers make invoices, quotes and receipts in editable Word (.docx) files with calculated totals. Document processing happens on the user's device. Its free business document kit contains six Word templates and instructions, with no email signup. It also turns ordinary Word templates with {tags} into guided questionnaires. Every library template can be downloaded or filled in free, with no account or document limit; up to three of the user's own templates are also free. Documents made from library templates on the Free plan end with a small "Made with Clausery" line. Pro ($19 per user per month or $190 per year) leaves that line out and adds unlimited own templates, calculations in those templates, unlimited documents from a spreadsheet, an encrypted workspace and client intake forms. Pro can be tried free for 14 days in the app with no card, and a first payment has a 30-day money-back guarantee.

Key facts:
- Documents are assembled in the browser; template files, answers and generated documents are never sent to a server.
- Templates are normal Word files. Tags: {name} for a value, {#condition}...{/condition} for optional text, {^condition}...{/condition} for the opposite, and {#list}...{/list} for repeating paragraphs or table rows.
- Pro plan: optional passphrase encryption of everything stored in the browser (AES-256-GCM) with auto-lock.
- Free Word templates, a contract clause library and free drafting tools are available without sign-up.
- Drafts save automatically, as the user types, to the browser's IndexedDB database. They survive reloads, restarts and closed tabs, stay until deleted, and move between devices with a backup file.
- The output is an editable Word .docx (printing to PDF is optional). A draft can be reopened, changed and downloaded again; each draft keeps a history of every document made from it, with the time and a SHA-256 fingerprint of the answers, and can restore earlier answers.
- Logic: conditional sections, show-when rules with expressions such as contract_value > 5000, and calculations. The free invoice, quote, purchase order, credit note and expense templates add up line items and tax.
- Repeat documents: a new invoice, quote, receipt, purchase order or credit note starts with the user's own details from the last one, the next number in their sequence and today's date; the client, items and amounts are never copied.
- Invoice templates by trade (contractor, cleaning, photography, consulting and more) open an invoice with that trade's usual lines; prices are always the user's own.
- Invoice templates by country (UK VAT, Ireland VAT, Australia GST, New Zealand GST, Canada GST/HST, South Africa VAT) open an invoice with that country's tax name, standard rate, tax number label and currency set up; each page lists what the tax authority requires and links to it.
- Billing workflows: a deposit invoice requests only the agreed upfront amount; an hourly invoice uses hours as quantities; a final invoice deducts actual payments from the full project total. Each has a worked example and a dedicated starter. The deposit page also calculates an agreed percentage and remaining balance locally.
- Bulk generation: one document per row of a CSV spreadsheet (Free plan: 5 per spreadsheet; Pro: unlimited), assembled in the browser.
- Not included, by design: e-signatures (users sign with their own e-signature service), live co-editing and server integrations. Documents can be handed to Mail, Slack or Teams with the system share sheet where supported.
- Library templates are general samples written mainly for the US, Canada and the UK; guides cite official sources. The only official site is getclausery.github.io, released regularly (see the changelog).
- Clausery is software, not a law firm, and does not give legal advice.

## Product
- [Home](https://getclausery.github.io/): Free invoice template you can fill in online and download as an editable Word doc or printable PDF. Calculate totals, VAT/GST/sales tax, discount and balance due automatically — no sign-up, no card, nothing uploaded. Not affiliated with Clausery.ai.
- [About Clausery (open-source invoice tool — not clausery.ai)](https://getclausery.github.io/about/): About Clausery, the independent open-source business making free Word invoices, quote and receipt generator for freelancers and small businesses. Not affiliated with Clausery.ai.
- [Pricing · Free forever · Pro $19/month (no card required)](https://getclausery.github.io/pricing/): Free forever: 87 Word templates, three of your own, unlimited documents. Pro is $19/user/month for unlimited templates, calculations, encryption and bulk-from-spreadsheet. 14-day free trial (no card), 30-day refund.
- [Why Clausery — no signup, no card, real Word files](https://getclausery.github.io/why-clausery/): See why Clausery is different from invoice apps and cloud document tools: editable Word output, no uploads, no account to start, a free tier that never expires, public source code and a money-back guarantee.
- [Free business document kit — 6 Word templates (no email)](https://getclausery.github.io/business-document-kit/): Download a free 6-template Word kit for small businesses: quote, scope of work, invoice, payment receipt, purchase order and credit note. No email signup, no account — one zip, editable .docx files.
- [Self-host Clausery on your domain or intranet](https://getclausery.github.io/self-hosting/): Self-host or white-label Clausery: deploy the open-source document generator to your own domain or intranet, with optional commercial licensing for rebranding, firm-wide rollout and integration.
- [Who uses Clausery](https://getclausery.github.io/customers/): Who uses Clausery: freelancers, consultants, small agencies, landlords, HR teams, service businesses and small law firms making Word invoices, contracts and letters without uploading anything.
- [Press kit](https://getclausery.github.io/press/): Clausery press kit: free Word invoices, quotes and receipts for small businesses, with product facts, pricing, reusable images and contact details.
- [Clausery roadmap](https://getclausery.github.io/roadmap/): What has shipped recently and what is being worked on next for Clausery, with links to the changelog and GitHub issues.
- [Clausery status](https://getclausery.github.io/status/): Current status of Clausery: public site, GitHub source, latest release, and where to check if something appears to be down.
- [Getting started](https://getclausery.github.io/docs/): Install nothing, sign up for nothing: tag a Word template, drop it into Clausery, answer the questions, download the document.

## Free tools
- [Free small-business calculators (Word, 2026)](https://getclausery.github.io/free-tools/): Free tools for drafting and invoicing: amount in words, deadlines, invoice due dates, late payment interest, loans, commission, prorated rent and more.
- [Amount in words converter for contracts and cheques](https://getclausery.github.io/free-tools/amount-in-words.html): Write any amount in words for contracts, cheques and promissory notes, such as "One Thousand Two Hundred and Fifty Dollars and 50/100".
- [Contract deadline calculator (business days, months, years)](https://getclausery.github.io/free-tools/deadline-calculator.html): Add or subtract days, business days, weeks, months or years from a date, with month-end handling and your own holidays.
- [Net 30 calculator: invoice due date for any payment terms](https://getclausery.github.io/free-tools/invoice-due-date.html): Find the due date for Net 30, Net 60, EOM, 15 MFI or 2/10 net 30 invoices, the days left to pay and what an early payment discount is worth.
- [Late payment interest calculator (contract or UK statutory)](https://getclausery.github.io/free-tools/late-payment-interest.html): Work out interest on an overdue invoice at your contract rate, or UK statutory interest at 8% above base rate plus the fixed compensation sum.
- [Freelance rate calculator: hourly and day rate](https://getclausery.github.io/free-tools/freelance-rate.html): Work back from the income you want to keep to the hourly and day rate you need to charge, after tax, costs and time off.
- [Loan repayment calculator with amortization schedule](https://getclausery.github.io/free-tools/loan-repayment.html): Work out the payment on a loan repaid in equal instalments, the total interest and a full repayment schedule with dates, for weekly to yearly payments.
- [Sales commission calculator with tiers and draw](https://getclausery.github.io/free-tools/sales-commission.html): Work out commission at a flat rate or with higher tiers above a sales target, the effective rate, and what is still due after a draw.
- [Prorated rent calculator for move-in and move-out](https://getclausery.github.io/free-tools/prorated-rent.html): Work out the rent for a partial month when a tenant moves in or out mid-month, by days in the month, a 365-day year or a 30-day month.
- [Word template tag checker](https://getclausery.github.io/free-tools/template-checker.html): Check a .docx template for broken {tags} and see the questionnaire it would produce. The file never leaves your computer.
